kyoto_obanzai_to_yasai_kamiya.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai and grilled dishes with soy-based seasoning; dumplings and salt yakisoba are wheat (2022–26 reviews).
kyoto_obanzai_to_yasai_kamiya.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetables lead, but obanzai and oden use dashi and there is chicken (Tabelog; 2022–26 reviews).
kyoto_obanzai_to_yasai_kamiya.hours_raw: 17:00–21:00; closed Tuesday; may close early without notice; see the website for closures (Tabelog). Bookings by phone or e-mail; a cancellation fee applies to no-shows (Tabelog). Charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「お通し代 あり」 — an appetizer charge. No cards; PayPay (Tabelog; official site). English menu (Tabelog). Children generally not allowed (Tabelog). 14 seats: 10 at the counter, 4 at tables; all non-smoking (official site). The shop notes its Tabelog page is not kept up to date. On the Kiyamachi riverside lane; 2 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn exit 2, 3 min from Sanjo Keihan (Tabelog; official site).
kyoto_obanzai_to_yasai_kamiya.notes: [Obanzai & sansho · Kiyamachi] A small adult counter bar on the Kiyamachi lane, with a tiny garden, built around sansho from its own farm: obanzai platters, grilled Miyama chicken, kinpira and highballs all tingling with it, and extra sansho on the table. About ¥4,000–8,000. Evenings only; cash or PayPay; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 25 January 2008 (Tabelog). Per the official site: a small, quiet adult drinking spot where one can unwind alone after work or sightseeing; sansho grown without pesticides on its own farm, and ingredients mainly from Miyama, Kyoto.
chef_bio.philosophy: Sansho dishes for their fresh aroma and distinctive tingle (official site).

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 diner praised dishes that gently bring out the ingredients, and above all the sansho ones.
An August 2026 traveller found the room homey and had fun adding the extra sansho on the table.
A February 2024 visitor went home with the red sansho and sansho pepper as souvenirs.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 内儀家 (かみや)、高瀬川沿い、上木屋町の閑静な佇まい、仕事帰りや観光後に一人でもほっと一息つける小さな大人の酒処、自家農園で無農薬栽培の山椒を使った山椒料理、京都・美山産を中心とした食材、全席禁煙、クレジットカード不可・PayPay 可、赤山椒「美山のルビー」の通販。食べログ: おばんざいと野菜 内儀家、居酒屋・野菜料理・焼き鳥、中京区木屋町通二条下ル上樵木町495-1 伊藤ビル1F、17:00〜21:00、火曜休み、お通し代あり、カウンター10席・テーブル4席、英語メニュー、子供は原則不可、メール予約可、無断キャンセルはキャンセル料、2008年1月25日オープン、食べログの情報は更新していない。口コミ (2022年2月〜2026年8月、英語): おばんざい盛り合わせ、山椒のきんぴら、美山の地鶏、山椒ハイボール、山椒の雲丹豆腐、焼き稲荷、卓上の山椒。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); counter seating; adults.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and the official site; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_saikaku_demachi.gf_detail: Ask. Dashi-based Kyoto cooking with soy, tempura and cha soba; no gluten information (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_saikaku_demachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-centred Kyoto cuisine in dashi (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_saikaku_demachi.hours_raw: Lunch Mon, Tue, Fri, Sun 12:00–13:30, booked by the day before; dinner Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Wednesday and the 3rd Tuesday (Tabelog). The official site gives 17:00–21:00. Bookings by phone; "a small shop — we would be glad if you booked" (official site). Course ¥12,000 or à la carte, plus consumption tax only (official site). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) (Tabelog). Counter, tables and a room with tatami (official site); 20 seats; children welcome (Tabelog). Tabelog lists parking; the official site says there is none, with coin parking in front (the street is one-way northbound). A short way into the Demachi shopping street, about 8 min from Demachiyanagi Stn or 5 min from the nearest city bus stop (official site; April 2024 review).
kyoto_saikaku_demachi.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Demachi shopping street] A calm little Kyoto restaurant off the Demachi arcade, by counter, table or tatami room: seasonal appetizers, a celebrated steamed dish of the season, and guji cooked whichever way you like. Course ¥12,000 or à la carte, plus tax only. Book ahead; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site, running since about 2008 (site copyright 2008–2026); its motto is 「ゆき過ぎず ひかえめに」 — never overdone, always restrained — following Kyoto's seasons in nourishing food. A July 2026 diner describes the owner and the hostess.
chef_bio.philosophy: Restrained cooking that follows the Kyoto seasons (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Guji prepared to order; the seasonal steamed dish.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 regular on a third visit had a favourite hotel's concierge book it, and likes that it serves à la carte.
A party of three in March 2026 shared one guji cooked three ways: head salt-grilled, middle simmered, tail fried.
An October 2026 diner ordered the chestnut steamed dish a second time.
A July 2026 diner called the owner and the hostess "true gentlemen and ladies".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 御料理 西角、上京区出町桝形、「ゆき過ぎず ひかえめに 京の四季の移ろいを 滋味あふれるお料理とともに」、コース12,000円〜・一品料理 (別途消費税のみ)、17:00〜21:00、毎週水曜・毎月第3火曜休み、カウンター・テーブル・お部屋 (畳、4名まで)、小さい店なので予約を、電話予約、駐車場なし (店の前にコインパーキング、北行き一方通行)、市バス河原町今出川から徒歩約5分、京阪出町柳駅から徒歩約8分。食べログ (店舗会員): 日本料理、上京区今出川通河原町西入ル三芳町134、ランチ (月火金日 12:00〜13:30、前日までに予約)、ディナー 17:00〜22:00、20席、カード可、子供可。口コミ (2023年8月〜2026年10月、英語): 八寸、季節の蒸し物 (栗、えんどう豆)、ぐじを焼き・酒蒸し・揚げ・煮付け・揚げ出しから選ぶ、天ぷら、ちりめんじゃこのご飯か茶そば、わらび餅、日本酒、ご主人と女将。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter, tables or a tatami room; book by phone.

kyoto_onikai_second.gf_detail: Ask. Dashi-simmered vegetables, sashimi with soy, shrimp cutlet and tempura; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_onikai_second.vegan_detail: Not vegan: vegetables are simmered in dashi; fish and beef dishes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_onikai_second.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 daily; closing days vary; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings via the website or by phone; full from opening on some nights (2026 reviews). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). On the 2nd and 3rd floors of a renovated machiya — look for a small sign and stairs; a counter wraps the kitchen, private rooms upstairs; non-smoking (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Dishes come in single or two-person portions (2026 reviews). 2 min from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog; September 2026 review).
kyoto_onikai_second.notes: [Kyoto vegetables & dashi · near Karasuma Oike] A young, upbeat counter upstairs in a renovated machiya: dashi-simmered seasonal vegetables, beef rolls with egg, an all-shrimp cutlet and a crisp-bottomed clay-pot rice you finish as chazuke. About ¥4,000–5,000. Daily from 17:00; book, it fills fast.

chef_bio.background: Opened 19 April 2026 (Tabelog). Reviewers place it in the 五十家 (Isoya) group as the second お弐かい, after the Kawaramachi shop (October 2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner liked that dishes come as individual portions, so nothing has to be shared, and found it packed from opening.
An October 2026 guest who called on spec got a 20:00 seat and found the young staff quick and efficient.
A group of four in October 2026 found the Kawaramachi お弐かい menu longer, but everything here just as good.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: お弐かいSECOND、居酒屋、中京区姉小路通室町東入柿本町411 2F・3F、烏丸御池駅から134m、17:00〜23:00 (定休日不定)、予約可、個室あり、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2026年4月19日オープン。口コミ (2026年9〜10月、英語): 五十家グループ、河原町のお弐かいの2号店、町家の改装、小さな看板と階段、厨房を囲むカウンター、若いスタッフ、名物の炊いた野菜 (なす、Kujo ねぎ、じゃがいも)、牛肉巻きと卵、生湯葉と揚げ湯葉、鯛のお造りに大葉なすのわさび醤油、なすと鱧のポン酢、ねぎとたこのぬた、穴子の山椒煮、海老100%の海老カツ、梨のシーザーサラダ、銀の土鍋ご飯を出汁で茶漬けに、一人前ずつの盛り付け。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter around the kitchen; staff explain dishes.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_charcoal_shijo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a menu: pasta (penne, peperoncino), bread with the ajillo, macaroni salad (2025–26 reviews). Ask about the charcoal-grilled meat and vegetables.
kyoto_charcoal_shijo.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, and the shop grills seasonal vegetables over charcoal (official site); most courses include meat and fish.
kyoto_charcoal_shijo.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; same-day cancellations are charged for the meals booked (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay, no e-money (Tabelog). 38 seats: a counter downstairs, sunken-kotatsu seating and private rooms upstairs; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog; June 2025). Heated tobacco only in a designated area; smoking outside the entrance (Tabelog). Children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). In an alley between Shijo and Nishinotoin; 3 min from Shijo Karasuma Stn exit 24 (Tabelog; September 2026). One unisex restroom, with a queue on a busy night (October 2025).
kyoto_charcoal_shijo.notes: [Charcoal grill and wine · Shijo Karasuma, a machiya in a back alley] A hidden machiya with a bar counter downstairs and sunken-kotatsu rooms upstairs, grilling seasonal vegetables and meat over charcoal to go with a long wine list — plus ajillo, appetizer platters and penne. Courses with all-you-can-drink from ¥5,500 suit groups; staff are lively, though big parties slow the kitchen. Open to midnight; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site (lotus0610.com): one of three shops in the same Shijo Karasuma back alley — the Italian bar スモーク＆グリル ロータス, this machiya dining room 炭火焼×ワイン チャコール with private rooms and sunken-kotatsu seats upstairs, and the standing bar スタンド酒場 ステム.
chef_bio.philosophy: Vegetables chosen down to harvest time and size, and carefully selected meat, each grilled over charcoal (official site).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 group of nine had a ¥5,500 course with all-you-can-drink upstairs; one guest found the red wine served too warm, and the staff cheerfully took the group photo.
A May 2026 diner loved the mashed potatoes with the steak and found the sunken-kotatsu seats surprisingly cosy for an Italian place.
An October 2025 diner liked the meat but found the rest average and queued 15 minutes for the single restroom.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 四条烏丸の路地裏の3店 (スモーク＆グリル ロータス、炭火焼×ワイン チャコール、スタンド酒場 ステム)、チャコールは町屋を改装した隠れ家のようなイタリアン、旬の野菜と厳選した肉の炭焼きと豊富なワイン、2階に個室と掘りごたつ席。食べログ: イタリアン・バル・居酒屋、中京区釜座通炭之座町416、四条烏丸駅24番出口から徒歩3分、月〜土17:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:00)、日曜休み、予約可 (当日キャンセルは料理代)、カード・PayPay 可、38席、加熱式たばこの喫煙所、子供可、ベジタリアンメニューあり。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年11月、英語): アヒージョとパン、前菜5種盛り、ステーキとマッシュポテト、ペンネ、しらすのペペロンチーノ、飲み放題付きコース5,500円、明るい店員、トイレが一つ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book and order à la carte or a course; friendly, energetic staff (2025–26 reviews). No English evidence found.

kyoto_yasaka_park_hyatt.gf_detail: Ask. Teppanyaki courses cooked with French technique — beurre blanc and other sauces, an onion soufflé (2022–25 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_yasaka_park_hyatt.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options; the courses centre on Omi and Kuroge wagyu, shrimp and fish (2022–26 reviews).
kyoto_yasaka_park_hyatt.hours_raw: Two dinner sittings daily, 17:00–19:30 and 20:00–22:30; open all year (Tabelog). Reservation only (Tabelog). Service charge 15% (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料15%」). Cards incl. UnionPay; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Counter seats around teppan stations facing the Yasaka Pagoda — 20 per Tabelog, 10 at two stations per a May 2022 review; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Guests aged 12 and over (Tabelog reservation notes; elsewhere Tabelog says 10 and over). No sleeveless sports tops, tank tops, sportswear or open-toed sandals; dress shorts are fine (Tabelog). Wheelchair accessible; hotel valet parking ¥2,000 for up to 4 hours with a restaurant visit (Tabelog). In Park Hyatt Kyoto, 6 min from the Higashiyama Yasui bus stop (Tabelog). Opened 30 October 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_yasaka_park_hyatt.notes: [Teppanyaki · Kodaiji, the Park Hyatt’s counter facing the Yasaka Pagoda] Park Hyatt Kyoto’s main dining room: teppan counters with the Yasaka Pagoda and the roofs of Higashiyama filling the window, where chefs cook Omi beef, shrimp and seasonal Kyoto produce with French sauces. Book a sitting near sunset. Courses from about ¥20,000, plus 15% service and pricey wine; English explanations. Guests 12 and over; no sportswear.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the teppanyaki and French restaurant of Park Hyatt Kyoto, opened 30 October 2019. A May 2022 review called it the hotel’s main dining room and named Chef Kanpei Kuki, formerly Michelin-starred at La Truffière in Paris, as bringing French technique to the teppan; no current source confirms who leads the kitchen now. A March 2022 review places it on the 4th floor.
chef_bio.specialty: Teppanyaki with French technique; Omi beef.

anecdotes.text: A May 2022 diner booked an hour before sunset to watch the Yasaka Pagoda over champagne, and called the 15% service charge “a body blow”.
An August 2025 diner on the day after the Okuribi watched an evening shower and then the sunset over the pagoda through the window.
An August 2024 diner found many overseas guests and the English explanations well done.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鉄板焼・フレンチ・イノベーティブ、東山区高台寺桝屋町360、Park Hyatt Kyoto 内、東山安井バス停から徒歩6分、毎日17:00〜19:30・20:00〜22:30、予約のみ、サービス料15%、カード可 (銀聯含む)、カウンター20席、12歳以上 (別項では10歳以上)、ドレスコード (スポーツウェア・タンクトップ・サンダル不可)、車椅子可、ベジタリアンメニューあり、2019年10月30日オープン。口コミ (2022年3月〜2026年8月、英語): 八坂の塔を望むカウンター、夕日の時間がおすすめ、鉄板でフランス料理の技法、Omi の牛肉のステーキ130g、Wakayama の海老、ワインとノンアルコールのペアリング、英語の説明、料理長の名前は2022年5月の口コミのみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas guests and well-done English explanations (August 2024). Book a sitting; guests 12 and over; no sportswear or open-toed sandals.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (hotel restaurant); reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_nanajou_futaba.gf_detail: Ask. Rice-cake sweets — mame mochi dusted with flour, daifuku, ohagi, dango, warabi mochi (2026 reviews); the dusting flour is not identified.
kyoto_nanajou_futaba.vegan_detail: Ask. Mochi, red peas and bean paste, but no ingredient information.
kyoto_nanajou_futaba.hours_raw: Wed–Sun 9:00–17:00; closed Monday and Tuesday (Tabelog). Take-away only. CASH ONLY — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; September 2026). Orders by phone (Tabelog). Goods may not be ready right at opening (September 2026), and by about 16:00 much has sold out (August 2026). On Shichijo east of Omiya; 2 min from the Shichijo Omiya bus stop (Tabelog).
kyoto_nanajou_futaba.notes: [Wagashi · Shichijo Omiya, the other Futaba mame mochi] A small shop on Shichijo selling mame mochi in the Futaba style — salted red peas and smooth bean paste in soft mochi, ¥250 — plus daifuku, ohagi, chestnut yokan and sekihan, with none of Demachi Futaba’s queues. Reviewers find it close to Demachi’s, a little different in texture and salt. Cash only; go early, as things sell out. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe the link to 出町ふたば differently: an August 2026 reviewer researched it and found it is not a branch but a separate shop; a September 2026 reviewer calls it a spin-off; other September and October 2026 reviewers call it a branch. No official source was found.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor bought mame mochi like those a seminar professor used to bring to class, with four left at about 16:00.
A September 2026 Kyoto regular cycles here instead of queueing for Futaba at Takashimaya, and found the salt and bean paste balance unmistakably Futaba.
A September 2026 visitor ate the mame mochi and chestnut yokan while waiting for the dolphin show at the nearby Kyoto Aquarium.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 和菓子・大福、下京区七条通大宮東入大工町120-2、七条大宮バス停から徒歩2分、水〜日9:00〜17:00、月火休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可。口コミ (2023年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 豆餅250円 (2024年8月は200円、2023年12月は180円)、豆大福2個500円、黒豆大福、栗大福、栗蒸し羊羹、おはぎ、月見団子、わらび餅、亥の子餅、栗赤飯 (小) 450円、夕方には売り切れも、出町ふたばとの関係は口コミにより「支店」「別の店」「暖簾分け」とさまざま。

cultural_comfort.note: Point and buy at the counter; cash only; pleasant staff (October 2026).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_yoshoku_anpurusu.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a menu: crab cream croquette, fried shrimp, chicken and fillet katsu, demi-glace hamburg steak (2023–26 reviews).
kyoto_yoshoku_anpurusu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamburg steak, beef stew, duck, shrimp and crab dishes (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_yoshoku_anpurusu.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–13:30, dinner 18:00–21:30 (last order 20:30); closed Tuesday, Wednesday and irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and, per the shop, a must; lunch can be fully booked (Tabelog; October 2025). Cards and PayPay, no e-money (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「なし」). A few counter seats at the front, tables down a narrow passage at the back with a window onto a shrine approach (November 2025). 3 min from Hankyu Omiya and Randen Shijo-Omiya Stns (Tabelog).
kyoto_yoshoku_anpurusu.notes: [Yoshoku bistro · Shijo Omiya, demi-glace and natural wine] A small neighbourhood yoshoku house where the owner-chef chats across the counter: a rich demi-glace hamburg steak, shrimp fry and crab cream croquette on the Anpurusu plate, beef stew and bistro à la carte at night, with natural wines and homemade canelés to finish. Regulars come back a dozen times; book, as lunch fills. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), who talks with guests at the counter (Tabelog, shop text)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): authentic bistro cooking at an affordable price, organic vegetables bought directly from producers, and natural wines and champagnes chosen to pair. An October 2025 first-timer felt it was a homey place run by a couple.
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic flavours in a relaxed setting, for special occasions or an ordinary meal (Tabelog, shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Demi-glace hamburg steak; the Anpurusu plate.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 regular on an eighth visit asked for a fruity white and was poured a southern French wine with a summer-citrus nose — and found the milk for the tea properly warmed.
An October 2025 diner, turned away from a fully booked lunch the month before, booked dinner and was the only party there.
A January 2026 diner ate the fried shrimp whole, head and all.

A February 2026 regular learned from the owner that the founder died about two years earlier and the son has taken over, and was shown a plaque explaining the name: 鳳城, from Du Fu’s poem “Night”, is an elegant name for Chang’an (Xi’an), chosen for the friendship between Xi’an — sister city of Kyoto since 1974 — and Kyoto. An October 2026 reviewer calls it a long-established restaurant “run by a family in a historic Kyoto townhouse”; an April 2026 diner found the owner very attentive.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 solo diner liked that any à la carte dish can come with a rice or mini fried rice set.
A January 2026 diner, put off by how greasy the half fried rice looked, found it delicious.

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); cash only; solo-friendly with set options.

kyoto_rakusenro_shijo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the specialty is boiled dumplings in wheat wrappers; noodle sets and fried dishes (official shop; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_rakusenro_shijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Chinese meat and seafood dishes; hot pot with lamb courses (2026 reviews).
kyoto_rakusenro_shijo.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30, dinner 17:30–22:00; irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, limited to two hours at busy times; cancel same-day by phone; full charge for no-shows on a booked course (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, original なし; the English page’s “10% service charge” is a mistranslation). Cards, IC, e-money and many QR codes (Tabelog). Tablet ordering, with staff taking orders for anyone who prefers (September 2026). 38 seats: 10 at the counter, 12 at tables, two semi-private rooms for 6–8, 10 on the terrace; smoking only on the terrace; dogs welcome on the terrace (Tabelog; September 2026). Wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). On Higashinotoin south of Shijo, 1 min from Hankyu Karasuma Stn exit 19 (Tabelog). Opened 1 August 1994 (Tabelog).
kyoto_rakusenro_shijo.notes: [Chinese and hot pot · Higashinotoin-Shijo, since 1994] A busy, friendly Chinese restaurant a minute from Shijo Karasuma, known for chewy boiled dumplings. Weekday lunch sets around ¥1,400 (dumplings and fried rice, sweet-and-sour pork); at night Chinese hot pot courses — lamb included — with a condiment bar, plus classic plates and Shaoxing wine. A terrace takes dogs and smokers. Tablet ordering; no service charge.

roles: Operated by 楽仙樓株式会社
chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s invoice number T7130001028310 is registered to 楽仙樓株式会社 at the restaurant’s own address (NTA register); opened in August 1994 (Tabelog). The official online shop sells its boiled dumplings. Reviewers praise quick, friendly service (2026); an October 2026 diner came after seeing it on television.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular brings a dog and sits on the terrace, which has a spot cooler and shade on hot days.
An October 2026 group of five ordered hot pot for the first time and never got to the noodles because the vegetables kept being refilled.

kyoto_kyo_dining_hachijo.gf_detail: Ask. Creative Western dishes with Kyoto ingredients — steak set, hamburg steak with fried shrimp, beef-cutlet curry, yuba and tofu salad; no gluten information (Tabelog shop text; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_dining_hachijo.vegan_detail: Ask. A fresh yuba and tofu salad is on the menu, but dressings and dashi are not described; most dishes are meat (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_dining_hachijo.hours_raw: 11:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00) daily (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Mobile ordering (October 2026). Cards, e-money and QR, PayPay (Tabelog; September 2026). 68 seats with a counter; private hire possible; non-smoking (Tabelog). In the Kyoto Omotenashi Koji restaurant row of ASTY Road, steps from the Shinkansen Hachijo Exit of JR Kyoto Station (Tabelog). Opened 13 November 2009 (Tabelog); formerly called Hachijo Diner (August 2026 review).
kyoto_kyo_dining_hachijo.notes: [Beer dining · Kyoto Station Hachijo Exit, a pre-Shinkansen stop] A machiya-fronted beer restaurant right by the Shinkansen gates, open 11:00–23:00: house Hachijo Beer and a Kyoto Highball with Western plates using local produce — hamburg and fried shrimp, steak sets, beef-cutlet curry, a yuba and tofu salad. One reviewer calls it a private “Shinkansen lounge” for a last beer in Kyoto.

chef_bio.background: No operator or chef is named in the sources opened. An August 2026 regular remembers it under its old name, Hachijo Diner, and still takes the same counter seat.
chef_bio.specialty: Hachijo Beer; Western dishes with Kyoto ingredients.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 traveller, used to an airport-lounge beer, called it “my own little lounge” next to the Shinkansen ticket gate.
An August 2026 couple chose it for a proper dinner before an evening Shinkansen because it was not crowded.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京ダイニング八条、ビアホール・ビアバー・バー、下京区東塩小路高倉町8-3 JR京都駅構内アスティロードレストラン街1F、JR京都駅八条口から徒歩1分、毎日11:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、68席、貸切可、禁煙、2009年11月13日オープン。店の紹介: 京都駅新幹線八条口の Kyoto Omotenashi Koji のビアレストラン、町家風の外観と洋風の店内、地元の食材を取り入れた創作洋食、限定の Hachijo Beer と Kyoto Highball、ランチもある。口コミ (2026年、英語): 以前は Hachijo Diner、手ごねハンバーグとエビフライのランチ2,380円、ステーキ定食、ビーフカツカレー、生湯葉と豆腐のサラダ、新幹線の前の一杯。

cultural_comfort.note: Station restaurant with mobile ordering; easy for travellers.

kyoto_bar_cerveceria_xativa.gf_detail: Ask. Paella and arroz, tapas, pinchos and bread-served ajillo; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_bar_cerveceria_xativa.vegan_detail: Ask. A seafood- and meat-led Spanish menu; nothing vegan is marked (reviews).
kyoto_bar_cerveceria_xativa.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 by reservation at least two business days ahead (phone preferred): a paella lunch ¥3,800 with ten tapas, paella, a drink and Basque cheesecake or chocolate cake, for 2–10 people upstairs. Dinner 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); Sunday and holidays 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 20 seats: 6 at the counter and 14 at tables, with a 2nd floor for private parties including families with small children; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), no e-money or QR (Tabelog). On Nijo-dori just west of Kiyamachi, opposite The Ritz-Carlton, Kyoto, 272 m from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; 2022–2024 reviews).
kyoto_bar_cerveceria_xativa.notes: [Spanish · Kiyamachi-Nijo, tapas and arroz by the Ritz-Carlton] A friendly little Spanish bar on Nijo-dori opposite The Ritz-Carlton, with a counter downstairs and a room upstairs. Pick pinchos and tapas, then share an arroz a banda or paella made with the day's market seafood; Spanish beers and plenty of wine. A tapas-and-paella lunch (¥3,800) runs by reservation only. Food can be slow when it is full. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: authentic Spanish regional dishes and homemade tapas in a quiet spot at Kiyamachi-Nijo, with fresh seafood bought daily at the market; the 2nd floor takes private parties and families with small children.
chef_bio.specialty: Arroz a banda; tapas and pinchos.

anecdotes.text: A November 2024 guest was offered a blanket and had a coat taken before ordering, then chose the arroz a banda over the classic paella.
An April 2026 couple upstairs found the food good but the wait very long on a full night.
A September 2026 diner found the owner kind, with a wonderful smile.

kyoto_tsukune_seisakujo.gf_detail: Ask. Tsukune in many seasonings, kara-age and sake snacks; no gluten information is published (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tsukune_seisakujo.hours_raw: 18:00–04:00 (last order food 03:00, drinks 03:30), Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 15 seats at a counter and tables; private hire up to 20; smoking allowed per Tabelog. Bookings recommended for early evening (April 2024). Hidden at the back of the 第二ふや町ビル on Fuyacho south of Nijo, 327 m from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Opened 17 April 2008 (Tabelog).
kyoto_tsukune_seisakujo.notes: [Izakaya · Fuyacho-Nijo, creative tsukune until 4 a.m.] A dim little izakaya at the back of a building near City Hall, open until 4 a.m. and devoted to tsukune — try the eight-kind platter or the raw tsukune — with a careful list of San'in sake served warm. Often run single-handed, relaxed for solo drinkers, with Hanshin baseball on the TV. Cash only; smoking allowed. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner not named; often run by one person (February 2025 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a tsukune-specialist izakaya opened 17 April 2008, with the owner’s blog as its website. A February 2025 reviewer describes it as run by a single person; other reviewers note the San’in sake list, warm sake and a Hanshin Tigers following.
chef_bio.specialty: Eight-kind tsukune platter; raw tsukune with kanzake.

anecdotes.text: A May 2023 late-night guest had the tsukune brought out one at a time, each in a different style, with warm Daigorei sake.
A February 2025 solo drinker found the one-person izakaya open until 4 a.m. just right.
A June 2025 passer-by came in for a sign offering ¥100 off drinks.

kyoto_shoku_kobo_hirosaki.gf_detail: Ask. Kappo-style Japanese cooking with soy, ponzu and dashi; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_shoku_kobo_hirosaki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seasonal fish-led kappo, e.g. fugu and crab in winter (reviews).
kyoto_shoku_kobo_hirosaki.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00, last entry 20:30; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Bookings recommended. Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 10 seats: a 6-seat counter and a semi-private tatami room for 4; non-smoking (Tabelog). Omakase about ¥27,000 (May 2023); recent reviewers spend ¥20,000–39,999 (2025–2026). On Takeya-machi-dori near Shinmachi, 191 m from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_shoku_kobo_hirosaki.notes: [Kappo · Marutamachi, a veteran's quiet counter] A small, unfussy kappo counter near Marutamachi Station run by a chef who spent years as head chef of Kiyamachi's 桜川. No flourishes — just seasonal fish and vegetables cooked with deep skill: winter fugu with shirako, crab clay-pot rice, the first tastes of spring. Six counter seats and one small room; omakase runs about ¥20,000–30,000. Cash only. Book ahead.

chef_bio.chef_name: Hirosaki (family name per a May 2023 review)
chef_bio.background: Per reviews: the chef went independent after many years — about 30, per a November 2015 reviewer — at 桜川 on Kiyamachi, including as its head chef (2011 and 2015 reviews). Reviewers in 2015 and 2017 said the restaurant had one Michelin star. A January 2025 regular has followed it for 25 years, since an earlier location. A May 2023 reviewer was welcomed by Mr. Hirosaki and a female member of staff.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per a 2011 review: cooking that brings out the natural flavour of seasonal ingredients with as little handling as possible.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal omakase; winter fugu and crab.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 regular had fugu sashimi mixed with fresh shirako and skin, and a crab clay-pot rice.
A February 2017 first-timer asked for extra dishes at the end and was happily obliged.
A January 2025 regular has been coming for 25 years, since the restaurant’s earlier location.

kyoto_bistro_kizano.gf_detail: Ask. French-based courses with bread or rice, soups, mousses and desserts; no gluten information is published (official site).
kyoto_bistro_kizano.vegan_detail: Ask. Courses are built on Kyoto vegetables but the mains are fish, pork, duck or beef; nothing vegan is offered on the published menus (official site).
kyoto_bistro_kizano.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last entry 13:30); dinner 18:00–22:00 (last entry 20:00); closed Monday and irregularly (official site). Course menus only for now; bookings of up to 6 people, about 2 hours a table; late cancellations or changes may be charged (official site). Cash only — no cards, cashless payments or local coupons (official site). Prices revised from 1 November (official site). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 16 seats per the official site (18 per Tabelog); non-smoking; children by prior arrangement; private hire for 15–20 (official site). On Karasuma-dori facing Higashi-Honganji, on the 1st floor of ベルセゾン京都駅前, about 7–10 min from JR Kyoto Stn (official site). Opened 26 March 2010 (Tabelog).
kyoto_bistro_kizano.notes: [French · facing Higashi-Honganji, Kyoto-vegetable bistro] A small bistro across Karasuma-dori from Higashi-Honganji, a short walk from Kyoto Station, run by a chef couple. Courses showcase Kyoto vegetables in French dress, eaten with chopsticks off Japanese plates: a pretty five-item appetizer platter, a seasonal potage, then fish, Kyoto pork or duck. Lunch ¥3,850–5,280, dinner ¥5,830–7,260. Cash only; groups up to six. Closed Monday.

roles: Run by a chef couple (official recruiting page); names not given
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: French-based creative cooking with Kyoto vegetables from contract farms and seafood sent direct from the producing areas; the most popular dish is the seasonal appetizer platter; the restaurant is run by a chef and spouse as a small, homely team. Opened 26 March 2010 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: Kyoto vegetables and local seasonings in Kyoto-style French, eaten with chopsticks from Japanese tableware.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal appetizer platter of Kyoto vegetables.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 visitor was told to mix the cold potato soup with the melon sorbet, and found it even better.
An August 2026 diner chose it from a book on business dining and found the room full of women at a Saturday dinner.
A December 2024 weekday lunch found every table taken by women enjoying wine.

kyoto_enya_sanjo_koji.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles, shumai and wonton wrappers, kara-age (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_enya_sanjo_koji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken broths, chicken chashu, meat and shrimp shumai (reviews).
kyoto_enya_sanjo_koji.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat lunch 11:30–15:30 and dinner 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); Thu dinner only; closed Sunday (a March 2025 diner noted lunch as 11:00–14:00). 20 seats — 10 at the counter and three tables; picture menu; non-smoking; cards, transit IC and most QR (Tabelog). Service charge: none — Tabelog’s Japanese original says 「なし」 (the English auto-translation wrongly says one is added). The entrance is on the alley side, easy to miss; look for the red lantern (2024–2026 reviews). Opened 4 December 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_enya_sanjo_koji.notes: [Chinese noodles & shumai · Sanjo alley near Karasuma Oike, white-miso noodles] A small "Kyoto Chinese" shop under a red lantern in a back alley, the sister of 円屋 near Shijo: the signature is a creamy Kyoto white-miso noodle soup, eaten with big, juicy steamed shumai, in a ¥1,300 lunch set. A December 2025 regular found the once-too-light broth much improved. No service charge. Closed Sunday; Thursday dinner only.

roles: Owner, not named; "cheerful, energetic, and very kind" (June 2026)
chef_bio.background: Opened 4 December 2024 (Tabelog), the second shop under the name 円屋 after the original near Shijo (Tabelog listing). Reviewers describe a counter around the kitchen, two or three tables in the back, a Taiwanese-looking front with a red lantern and a Japanese-modern interior, a friendly owner and manager, and set lunches where you pick the noodles.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 regular had stayed away after the ramen "had become quite light," came back for the first anniversary, and found it "now has a richer depth and umami" — with a free sweet at the till.
The same regular, in August 2026, wished for a set without rice: "I’ve thought this since the restaurant opened and even mentioned it to them once."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 円屋 三条小路店、中華料理・居酒屋・麺類、中京区新町通六角上る三条町342、烏丸御池駅から徒歩5分、月火水金土 11:30〜15:30・17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、木曜は夜のみ、日曜休み、20席 (カウンター10、テーブル3)、写真付きメニュー、禁煙、カード・交通系IC・QR可、サービス料は原文で「なし」、2024年12月4日オープン。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年9月、英語): 京都の白味噌の麺が名物、京都のワンタン麺、黒胡麻の辛い混ぜ麺、夏の冷やし麺、麺は900円 (限定1,000円)、焼売セット・唐揚げセット1,300円 (ご飯と高菜)、前菜盛り合わせ600円、焼売盛り合わせ650円、梅酒の水割り550円、黒七味、胡麻団子、赤提灯、路地の奥、店主は明るく元気、開店当初より味が良くなったという声、ご飯なしのセットがほしいという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Picture menu; order by telling the staff.

kyoto_bistro_verjus.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: cutlets, fried shrimp, hamburg steak, pound cake, bread with the courses (official site; reviews).
kyoto_bistro_verjus.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a bistro of beef, pork, chicken and fish (official site).
kyoto_bistro_verjus.hours_raw: Official site: lunch 12:00–14:30, dinner 18:00–22:00; Tuesday lunch only; Thursday dinner only; closed Wednesday; occasional closures posted in its news. 16 seats per the site (Tabelog: 20, five tables); private hire for 10–16; reservations advised, lunch often full (December 2024; April 2026). Non-smoking; children welcome; cards (JCB, Amex, Diners), e-money and QR (Tabelog). One parking space nearby and a temple car park (Tabelog; April 2025).
kyoto_bistro_verjus.notes: [French bistro & yoshoku · Kawabata-Nijo, a couple’s neighbourhood bistro] A small bistro near the Kamo River at Nijo, run by chef 小川 潤 in the kitchen and his wife out front: ¥1,100 lunches of Kyoto pork or hamburg steak, ¥2,700 lunch courses, and French dinner courses from ¥4,200 with vegetables he grows himself. Regulars swap the main for the house hamburg steak and fried shrimp. Book lunch. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a small bistro serving traditional French technique at reasonable prices, from everyday lunch to special dinners, in a quiet residential area; the owner-chef grows organic vegetables himself, uses domestic kuroge wagyu, and gets fish direct from a fisherman acquaintance in Miyazu. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a couple — "The front of house is managed by the wife, and the chef is her husband" — chatting with regulars, sending postcards, and roses at the door in spring.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「シンプルに旬の素材の味を引き出すこと」 — simply drawing out the flavour of seasonal ingredients.
chef_bio.specialty: Hamburg steak with fried shrimp; Kyoto pork grill.

anecdotes.text: "The front of house is managed by the wife, and the chef is her husband, making it a lovely couple-run establishment." — July 2026.
A four-time regular in June 2026: "I enjoy chatting with the owner and his wife," and always swaps the main for the hamburg steak and fried shrimp.
April 2026: the fully booked room left the staff "a bit rushed," and the diner asked that the corner furniture be cleaned.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (bistro-verjus.com): BISTRO Verjus (ビストロ ヴェルジュ)、オーナーシェフ 小川 潤、本格フレンチをカジュアルに、オーナーシェフ自家栽培の有機野菜、国産の黒毛和牛、宮津の知人漁師から直送の魚、ランチ12:00〜14:30・ディナー18:00〜22:00、火曜はランチのみ、木曜はディナーのみ、水曜休み、16席、10〜16人で貸切、おすすめランチ1,100円 (スープ付き1,510円)、鮮魚ランチ1,300円、ヴェルジュコースランチ2,700円、お魚のコースランチ3,020円、黒毛和牛コースランチ5,130円、特製ハンバーグ、エビフライとハンバーグ、京都ポークグリル、そば粉のガレット、ドリンク220円・デザート200円、ディナーコースA 4,200円・B 6,000円・C 7,000円、プチディナーコース2,900円、黒毛和牛ステーキ100〜200g 4,100〜7,500円、スモーク料理、ブイヤベース2,400円、仔羊のロースト2,900円、税込。食べログ: フレンチ・洋食、左京区二条通川端東入ル難波町218、川端二条バス停から徒歩2分、20席、子供可、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年7月、英語): 夫婦で営む、奥さんが接客でご主人がシェフ、常連はハンバーグとエビフライ、昼は満席が多い、温かい接客、ポストカード、入口のバラ、混んで慌ただしかった・隅の家具の掃除をという声。

cultural_comfort.note: A neighbourhood bistro; book ahead for lunch.

kyoto_2eme_maison.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pasta, focaccia sandwiches, shrimp tempura, cutlets, chicken nanban and pies (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_2eme_maison.vegan_detail: Not vegan: steak, hamburg, chicken, clam chowder, rillettes, pudding (reviews).
kyoto_2eme_maison.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:30–23:00, dinner from 17:00; hours may change. Reservations for dinner from 17:00 only; at lunch, queues form before opening (October 2026). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Non-smoking; children welcome; counter seating. An August 2026 diner found the Tabelog phone number out of service but the Google Maps number worked. Opened 20 July 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_2eme_maison.notes: [Café & dining bar · Gojo, antique-styled lunch spot] A dim, antique-filled café three minutes from Kiyomizu-Gojo: hearty lunch plates — steak, hamburg with shrimp tempura, chicken nanban with lemon tartare — then wine, rillettes and vongole at night, with cherry or fig pie any time. Popular, with queues at opening and many visitors from abroad. One diner found lunch with a drink over ¥2,000 a bit much. Dinner bookings only.

chef_bio.background: Opened 20 July 2022 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2024–2026 describe a stylish café with an antique, overseas feel and a slightly dim, calming interior, busy at lunch with many customers from abroad, daily and weekly specials that change often, and a cosy night-bar mood after dark.

anecdotes.text: September 2026: the pudding "had lost its shape," so the staff "kindly offered a scoop of vanilla ice cream as a complimentary treat."
An October 2026 diner found two queues at opening — "they were keeping track of the order in which people lined up" — and a set with a drink "over JPY 2000, which seemed a bit much."
August 2026: the cold corn-soup pasta was good, but "as I ate, it felt a bit watery and the flavor gradually became lighter."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 2eme MAISON (ドゥージィエムメゾン)、カフェ・アジア・エスニック・ダイニングバー、下京区寺町通り五条上る西橋詰町794、清水五条駅から徒歩3分、毎日 11:30〜23:00 (ディナー17:00〜23:00)、予約は17時からのディナーのみ、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、禁煙、子供可、カウンター席、2022年7月20日オープン。口コミ (2024年2月〜2026年10月、英語): アンティークで海外のような雰囲気、少し暗く落ち着く、ステーキランチ、ハンバーグ、海老天とハンバーグのミックスプレート、チキン南蛮のレモンタルタル、週替わりのミラノ風カツ、季節のパスタ (冷たいコーンスープのパスタ)、サーモンとクリームチーズのフォカッチャサンド、クラムチャウダー、リエット、ピクルス、ボンゴレ、チェリーパイ、無花果とキャラメルのパイ、大きなプリン、ブランデーケーキ、開店前に行列、海外からの客が多い、食べログの電話番号は不通でGoogleマップの番号はつながった (2026年8月)、ドリンク付きで2,000円超は高めという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Many visitors from abroad; dinner bookings only.

kyoto_tenyu_tempura.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura in wheat batter, a tendon, and fresh wheat gluten among the dishes (official menu; 2025 reviews).
kyoto_tenyu_tempura.vegan_detail: Not vegan: shrimp, conger eel and fish tempura; dashi dipping sauce; seasonal hamo, soft-shell turtle and fugu (official menu; reviews).
kyoto_tenyu_tempura.hours_raw: Official site: lunch from 11:30 (last order 13:00), dinner from 17:30 (last order 19:00); closed Tuesday plus two other days a month, listed in its monthly notices (Tabelog: Wednesdays are often irregular closures). Online booking via TableCheck. 22 seats — a 10-seat counter upstairs, private rooms of 4 and 6 (or 8) downstairs; private hire of either floor; corkage ¥3,300; no shorts or tank tops, no strong scent (Tabelog). Children welcome, private rooms suggested. Wheelchair accessible, with a lift (Tabelog; August 2025). Cards; no e-money or QR. Service charge: none — Tabelog’s Japanese original says 「なし」 (the English auto-translation wrongly says one is added). Prices revised in September 2026 (official site). Opened 30 May 1994 (Tabelog).
kyoto_tenyu_tempura.notes: [Tempura · Fuyamachi near Tawaraya Ryokan, the inn’s tempura house] The tempura restaurant of Tawaraya Ryokan, close to the inn on the same street: an alley and garden lead to a ten-seat counter upstairs and private rooms below. Light, cottonseed-oil tempura — conger eel, shrimp, Kamo eggplant — from a ¥4,950 tendon lunch to kaiseki tempura at ¥22,000–33,000 (2026 prices). Two 2025 diners found the counter hectic because tempura for both floors is fried upstairs. No service charge. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Head chef not named; run by Tawaraya Ryokan, which its site calls the main house (本店)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Ten’yuu stands close to its main house, Tawaraya Ryokan; it uses Kyoto’s deep plots to make an alley so both the counter and the private rooms look onto their own gardens; it fries in cottonseed oil for a light finish. Its related facilities are Tawaraya Ryokan and Gallery Yukei (ギャラリー遊形). Opened 30 May 1994 (Tabelog). Two August 2025 diners call it a Michelin one-star tempura restaurant.

anecdotes.text: October 2025: "I felt a bit rushed as the tempura for both the first and second floors was being fried on the second floor, creating a bustling atmosphere similar to a casual diner."
A September 2025 diner drank every drop of the dipping sauce; the owner said there was nothing special in it, but it had plenty of grated daikon and half a kabosu squeezed in.
March 2026: a walk-in on a weekday afternoon got fuki-no-tou tempura — "The flavors reminded me of Tawarayasan, with a careful and gentle taste."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ten-you.jp): 点邑 (てんゆう)、本店の俵屋旅館にほど近い麩屋町、京都の奥行きのある土地に路地を設け、カウンターからも個室からも庭を楽しめる、2階にカウンター10席、1階に4人と6人の個室、綿実油であっさり揚げた天ぷら、昼は天ぷらどんぶりやてんぷらコース、夜は懐石てんぷらコース、昼11:30から (L.O. 13:00)、夜17:30から (L.O. 19:00)、火曜休み・月2回の店休日、TableCheckで予約、2026年9月に価格改定、関連施設は俵屋旅館とギャラリー遊形。お品書き (2026年9月、税込): 昼 天ぷらどんぶり4,950円、点心てんぷら13,200円、懐石天ぷら はなみずき18,700円、夜 懐石天ぷら さざんか22,000円、つばき27,500円、ぼたん33,000円 (鱧しゃぶ・丸なべ・てっちりなど季節のお料理)、鱧・すっぽん・ふぐは相談、折詰。食べログ: 天ぷら・日本料理、中京区麩屋町三条上ル下白山町299、22席、個室、持ち込み料3,300円、服装と香りの注意、子供可、車椅子可、カード可、サービス料は原文で「なし」、1994年5月30日オープン。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年8月、英語): ミシュラン一つ星、俵屋旅館の天ぷら店、穴子、海老と海老の頭、大葉巻きの鰻、鱚、賀茂茄子、とうもろこし、ふきのとう、締めは天丼・天茶・じゃこご飯、大根おろしとかぼすの天つゆ、1階と2階の天ぷらを2階で揚げるので慌ただしいという声 (2件)、外国人客が多い。

kyoto_kissa_inon_marutamachi.gf_detail: Not GF: the signature is an egg sandwich on soft bread (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kissa_inon_marutamachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Organic herbal teas, coffee and a ginger-muscat float appear, but food centres on egg sandwiches and coffee jelly with ice cream (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kissa_inon_marutamachi.hours_raw: From 10:30, lunch from 11:00; closing time not listed; closed Tuesday and some irregular days; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). 20 seats incl. a counter and a large shared table; terrace seats where pets are allowed; non-smoking (Tabelog; November 2025). Cash, and PayPay per an April 2026 review; no cards (Tabelog). Picnic sets for rent to take to the riverbank (June 2026). Inside a flower shop on Marutamachi-dori by the Kamo River, east of Higashi-Sanbongi; about 140 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kissa_inon_marutamachi.notes: [Café · flower shop by the Kamo River, Marutamachi] A little café inside a flower shop a step from the Kamo River: watch walkers and joggers from the counter over an egg sandwich of fluffy dashimaki with crunchy homemade mustard, coffee jelly or a herbal tea, surrounded by fresh and dried flowers. Pick up a bouquet, or rent a picnic set for the riverbank. Pets welcome on the terrace. From 10:30; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a coffee shop with a flower shop on site, near Jingu-Marutamachi, with terrace seats open to pets. Reviewers describe a former flower shop that still sells flowers (November 2025), many regulars (July 2026), and staff who build bouquets around a guest's taste and budget (September 2026).

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 visitor was served the egg sandwich untoasted that day because the bread was freshly baked and fluffy.
A June 2026 guest saw young people borrow picnic sets and carry takeaway food down to the Kamo River.
A September 2026 visitor ordered a bouquet, chatted while it was made, then took photos by the river.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 喫茶店・カフェ、上京区丸太町通東三本木東入ル俵屋町463、神宮丸太町駅から140m、10:30から、ランチは11:00から、火曜と不定休、予約不可、20席、カウンター、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、花屋を併設、テラス席はペット可。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年9月、英語): 鴨川のそば、生花とドライフラワーに囲まれた店内、玉子サンド880円 (ふわふわのだし巻き、自家製の粒マスタード)、コーヒーゼリー (アイス添え)、オーガニックのハーブティー650円 (Tulsi)、アールグレイのアイスティー、生姜とマスカットのシャーベットのフロート、ピクニックセットの貸し出し、花束は2,000円ほどから予算に合わせて、PayPay 可 (2026年4月の口コミ)、常連が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; cash or PayPay; flowers sold too.

kyoto_takehisa_marutamachi.gf_detail: Ask. An omakase of hassun, sashimi, dobin-mushi, grilled ayu and clay-pot rice, seasoned with miso and soy; fried figs in spring-roll pastry appear (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_takehisa_marutamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-led Japanese omakase — ayu, conger eel, sashimi, sweet shrimp (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_takehisa_marutamachi.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–14:30 (last entry 13:00) and 17:30–22:30 (last entry 19:00); irregular closing days (Tabelog). Reservation only (Tabelog). No service charge or cover charge (Tabelog original サービス料、チャージ料なし). Omakase about ¥12,000–14,000 (2024–2025 reviews). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 8 counter seats; shoes off at the entrance; private hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2024). On Takeyamachi-dori east of Muromachi; 3 min walk west from Marutamachi Stn exit 5 (Tabelog).
kyoto_takehisa_marutamachi.notes: [Japanese omakase · Takeyamachi Muromachi near Marutamachi] A shoes-off, eight-seat counter cooking the Kyoto seasons into one omakase of about ¥12,000–14,000: grilled ayu with roe in late summer, matsutake and conger eel in autumn, chestnut rice and a warm chestnut kinton, and in spring wild taranome the chef gathers in the mountains. No service charge. Cash only; reservation only.

roles: Chef (unnamed), who forages wild mountain vegetables in spring (March 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a reservation-only, eight-seat counter for adults to enjoy seasonal ingredients; registered as an official listing by the shop. A March 2026 reviewer writes that the chef goes into the mountains to gather taranome, so some days there is none; an October 2024 reviewer notes summer heat had delayed both ayu and chestnuts that year; the summer noren is white (September 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: A hidden place for adults to savour seasonal ingredients (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: One regular has logged over sixty visits on Tabelog, returning several times in October 2026 for the overlap of ayu with roe and chestnuts.
An October 2024 guest heard of the chestnut rice at a dinner a year earlier and waited a full season to try it.
A September 2025 guest was astonished to find matsutake at this price, the first of the year.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、中京区竹屋町通室町東入亀屋町141-1、地下鉄丸太町駅5番出口から西へ徒歩約3分、12:00〜14:30 (最終入店13:00)、17:30〜22:30 (最終入店19:00)、不定休、完全予約制、サービス料・チャージ料なし、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、8席 (カウンター)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、旬の食材を味わう大人の隠れ家。口コミ (2024年10月〜2026年10月、英語): 靴を脱いで上がる、おまかせ12,000〜14,000円ほど、柿の白和え、八寸 (洋梨のコンポート、黒豆の枝豆、子持ち鮎、黄身の味噌漬け)、お造り (おろしたてのわさび)、土瓶蒸し、松茸のお椀、鱧、鮎の塩焼き、無花果の春巻き揚げ、秋刀魚の煮物、青梅の甘露煮、兵庫の甘海老、栗ご飯、温かい栗きんとん、シェフが山で採る天然のたらの芽 (2026年3月)、夏は白いのれん、青梅のソーダ、梅酒ソーダ。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; shoes off; one omakase; cash only.

kyoto_rebondie_ichijoji.gf_detail: Not GF: a wheat bakery of cornets, croissants, loaves and filled breads (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_rebondie_ichijoji.vegan_detail: Ask. Country bread and baguettes may suit, but there is no ingredient information; most items use butter, cream, cheese, egg or meat (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_rebondie_ichijoji.hours_raw: Friday–Wednesday 7:00–18:00; closed Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). The cornets often sell out by midday (2025–2026 reviews). Reservations (orders) accepted; reserved items are set aside (Tabelog; April 2026). No cards; e-money and QR incl. PayPay (Tabelog; March 2025). Takeaway; no parking — coin parking nearby (Tabelog; April and October 2026). A red-roofed shop on the 1F of North Point M in Ichijoji Umenoki-cho; near the Ichijoji Umenoki-cho bus stop, about 7 min from Ichijoji Stn on the Eizan line (Tabelog; June 2025, April 2026).
kyoto_rebondie_ichijoji.notes: [Bakery · Ichijoji, red roof] A red-roofed Ichijoji bakery known for its crisp cornet, filled with fresh cream at the till while you wait — come before noon or it is gone. Around it: a premium sliced loaf, croissants, salted-butter rolls, French peanut bread, weekend quiche and plenty of savoury breads such as spiced bacon, eggplant gratin and a mentaiko egg sandwich. PayPay but no cards. From 7:00; closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a bread and sandwich shop in Ichijoji with takeaway; orders by reservation. Reviewers describe the signature cornet filled at the register (November 2024), items set aside for reservations (April 2026), and breads fresh from the oven through the morning (July 2025).

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 pair walked in at 9:30 just as the sausage French came out of the oven, and split one while it was hot.
A May 2026 visitor arriving around 13:00 grabbed one of the last cornets and had it filled with two creams.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: パン・サンドイッチ、左京区一乗寺梅ノ木町54-1 ノースポイントM 1F、叡山電鉄「茶山」か「一乗寺」、市バス「一乗寺梅ノ木町」、金〜水 7:00〜18:00、木曜定休、予約可、カード不可、電子マネー・QR 可、禁煙、駐車場なし、テイクアウト。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 赤い屋根、名物のCorne Crisp 227円 (レジで生クリームを詰める、3種から2種のハーフ&ハーフも)、昼までに売り切れることが多い、プレミアム食パン5枚443円、クロワッサン216円、あんぱん205円、French Peanut 194円、塩バターパン217円、Butter Coupe、りんごとカスタードの Fleur 227円、クリームパン227円、きなこドーナツ119円、ツイストドーナツ173円、ほうれん草とサーモンのキッシュ410円 (週末)、ピザパン238円、茄子のグラタン238円、French Spiced Bacon、ソーセージフランス、フランクドーナツ、明太子の玉子サンド、PayPay 可。

kyoto_shimogamo_daitoryu.gf_detail: Not GF: Chinese dishes in soy-based sauces, gyoza, spring rolls, fried rice and noodles alongside yakiniku with dipping sauces (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shimogamo_daitoryu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Chinese, Korean and yakiniku dishes built on pork, beef, shrimp and egg (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shimogamo_daitoryu.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Friday–Sunday 17:00–23:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised (Tabelog; December 2025, May 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Counter, tables and tatami rooms; non-smoking; children welcome; 3 parking spaces in front (Tabelog; December 2025). Shimogamo, near Shimogamo Shrine; about 380 m from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog; January 2026). Leftovers can be taken home (June 2026).
kyoto_shimogamo_daitoryu.notes: [Chinese and yakiniku · Shimogamo, local favourite] A busy, family-filled neighbourhood restaurant near Shimogamo Shrine that does three things at once: wok-loud local Chinese (black fried rice, homemade spring rolls, Sichuan steamed pork, mapo tofu), yakiniku of thick tongue and lean cuts, and Korean plates with soju. Fast, generous and cash only; one 2026 guest found the tongue tough and the steamed pork heavy. Book ahead. Evenings; closed Wednesday and Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: Chinese, yakiniku and tripe near Demachiyanagi with tatami rooms and parking. Reviewers in 2025–2026 call it a long-established local Chinese restaurant that also offers Hong Kong and Korean dishes and yakiniku (August 2025; July 2026), with dishes served astonishingly fast to the sound of high-heat woks (July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Black fried rice; thick salted tongue.

anecdotes.text: Every Obon a group of local classmates holds its reunion here — August 2025 and again in August 2026.
A June 2026 solo diner who over-ordered was offered a box for the leftovers.
A January 2026 visitor had long noticed the car park always full before finally coming for the fried rice and gyoza.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 中華料理・焼肉・ホルモン、左京区下鴨宮崎町123、出町柳駅から376m、月・火・金〜日 17:00〜23:00、水・木曜定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンター、座敷、禁煙、子ども可、駐車場3台。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年9月、英語): 下鴨神社の近く、昔からの町の中華、香港と韓国の料理も、焼肉も、自家製の春巻き、餃子、黒チャーハン、あんかけの海鮮チャーハン、エビマヨ、鶏とカシューナッツ、四川風の蒸し豚、酢豚、麻婆豆腐、あさりの麺、豚と木耳の卵炒め、厚切りの塩タン、カルビ、和牛の上バラ、ハラミ、レバー、赤身の盛り合わせ、トック、キムチ、Chamisul、干し豆腐のサラダ、提供が早い、残りは持ち帰り可、予約がおすすめ、タンが硬く蒸し豚が重いとの声 (2026年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Long menu in Japanese; book ahead; cash only; parking for three cars.

kyoto_kyo_yakiniku_yoshida.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: yakiniku sauces and soy-marinated cuts, warm noodles and cold noodles (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_yakiniku_yoshida.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku house (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_kyo_yakiniku_yoshida.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sun 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Monday. 20 seats including a private room (March 2026); non-smoking; cards (Visa, Master, JCB, Amex, Diners), no e-money. The shop says it revamped its menu for "better quality at a lower price," with an average spend of ¥4,500–5,900 a head (Tabelog); reviewers in 2024–2026 still found it pricey (¥6,000–15,000). Tabelog lists no service charge.
kyoto_kyo_yakiniku_yoshida.notes: [Yakiniku · Karasuma-Gojo, wagyu in a stylish room] A calm, stylish wagyu yakiniku house by Gojo Station: thick-cut special loin and kalbi, grilled sirloin-cap "sashimi", yaki-shabu and a soy-marinated sliced beef that one diner rated above the pricier cuts. Most reviewers call it delicious but pricey; a 2023 diner found the menu far dearer than Tabelog showed, and a March 2026 family found the private room cold from the air duct. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2024–2026 describe a clean, stylish, low-odour room near the Karasuma-Gojo crossing with a private room, kind staff, and high-grade wagyu. The shop’s Tabelog blurb says it reworked its menu and policy after guests asked for "better quality at a lower price."

anecdotes.text: August 2023: "Menu differs too much from the official one, and the price increase is outrageous!" — an assorted sliced platter at ¥4,900 and a thick-cut platter at ¥7,900.
March 2026: "The air from the duct was really strong and it was honestly quite cold (laughs)" — blankets were brought; no bibimbap, and only two cold-noodle soups.
April 2026: after the high-end dishes, "the most delicious item was the affordable marinated offcuts in soy sauce."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京やき肉よし田、焼肉・ホルモン、下京区横諏訪町313-1、地下鉄五条駅4番出口から、火〜日 17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、月曜休み、20席、禁煙、カード可、電子マネー不可、「より良い品質をより安く」の声に応えてメニューを改訂、平均予算1人4,500〜5,900円。口コミ (2023年8月〜2026年7月、英語): 厚切り3種盛り (特上ロース・特上カルビ・特上赤身)、切り落としの盛り合わせ、和牛ハラミ1,000円、カルビ1,000円、上タン塩、イチボ、和牛ランプの炙り刺し、特選和牛の焼きしゃぶ、切り落としの醤油漬けと卵、ミノ、シマチョウ塩、京キムチ、ナムル、サンチュ、和風温麺、冷麺、自家製サワー、おしゃれで落ち着いた店内、個室、値段は高めという声が多い、2023年には食べログのメニューより大幅に高いという声、個室の空調が寒かった (2026年3月)、ビビンバはない。

cultural_comfort.note: Order by the cut; book ahead.

kyoto_la_pleine_lune.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: courses come with bread and pastry desserts (official site; reviews).
kyoto_la_pleine_lune.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg starter, fish, wagyu, cheese and cream (official site; reviews).
kyoto_la_pleine_lune.hours_raw: Tabelog: lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 13:30), dinner 18:00–23:00 (last order 21:00); closed Wednesday and one other irregular day a month. Course prices include tax and a 5% service charge (official site; Tabelog, Japanese original 「サービス料5％」). No cards at lunch (official site); cards (Visa, Master, JCB) at dinner. Groups of five or more get a set omakase course. 16 seats, counter and tables; non-smoking.
kyoto_la_pleine_lune.notes: [French · Karasuma-Nijo, classic cooking and Burgundy] A sixteen-seat French restaurant founded in 2006 by owner-chef 西居 直映, at Karasuma-Nijo since 2016: classic dishes — the egg in its shell, foams, sea bass in cream — with Burgundy the chef pours for you. Lunch ¥4,000–6,300 and dinner ¥6,400–12,000 including tax and service. No cards at lunch. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: La Pleine Lune opened in 2006 at 烏丸綾小路 as a ten-seat restaurant, and moved to Karasuma-Nijo in its tenth year, 2016, to serve classic French cooking with the Burgundy wines the chef loves; it marked 20 years on 27 May 2026. Tabelog gives the current site’s opening as 10 September 2016. A May 2026 diner remembers a ¥2,000 French lunch at the old address.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「時代を超えて愛されるクラシカルなフランス料理」 with Burgundy, in a quiet room — to be a restaurant where people spend good time.
chef_bio.specialty: Oeuf brouillé in the shell; Burgundy pairings.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner who knew the old shop: the first dish, the egg, "is a dream food for us middle-aged folks—it’s the same as in Lupin III."
June 2024: flavours "comparable to a Michelin 1-star," but "there are many visible clutter around, and the cooking oil smoke can be a bit overwhelming."
A six-time regular at Christmas 2024: "The chef always selects the wine for us."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (la-pleine-lune.com): フランス料理とブルゴーニュワインのお店 ラ プレーヌ リュヌ、2006年に烏丸綾小路で10席の店として開業、2016年に烏丸二条へ移転、時代を超えて愛されるクラシカルなフランス料理とブルゴーニュワイン、オーナーシェフ 西居 直映、2026年5月27日で20周年、ランチ Menu A 4,000円・Menu B 5,200円・シェフお任せ6,300円 (前日まで)、ディナー Menu A 6,400円・Menu B 8,600円・プレジール12,000円 (2日前まで)、税とサービス料5%込み、黒毛和牛ランプのロースト+1,200円、チーズ+600円、苺のスープとココナッツのブランマンジェ、ランチはクレジットカード不可、5名以上はおまかせ、夏は桃のスープやデザート。食べログ: フレンチ、中京区二条通高倉西入ル松屋町55-1 西本ビル 2F、烏丸御池駅から徒歩約6分、昼12:00〜15:00・夜18:00〜23:00、水曜休みと月1回の不定休、16席、禁煙、カード (VISA・Master・JCB)、サービス料5%、2016年9月10日オープン。口コミ (2018〜2026年、英語): 殻に入った卵の料理、きのこの泡のスープ、スモークサーモンと蟹、スズキのクリームソース、鮎のコンフィ、シェフがワインを選ぶ、移転前は2,000円のランチ、ミシュラン一つ星並みの味だが店内に物が多く油煙が気になるという声 (2024年6月)。

kyoto_assemblages_plus.gf_detail: Ask: gelato and kakigori may be wheat-free, but toppings include meringue, tuile, macarons, cookie dough and baked sweets; lunch is pizza (2026 reviews). Tabelog says allergy information is available.
kyoto_assemblages_plus.vegan_detail: Not vegan: milk gelato and milk-ice kakigori, custard, meringue (2026 reviews).
kyoto_assemblages_plus.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Thu, Fri, Sat 12:00–21:00; Sun 12:00–18:00 (Monday holidays follow Sunday hours); closed Tuesday and Wednesday. Lunch and café 12:00–17:00, dinner 18:00–21:00, with different menus. 9 counter seats on the ground floor around a single wooden slab, and about 20 free seats upstairs for sweets (Tabelog; August 2026). Reservations taken; day-of changes by phone. Non-smoking; children welcome; allergy information available; cards, no e-money or QR. Service charge: none — Tabelog’s Japanese original says 「無し」. Opened 6 November 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_assemblages_plus.notes: [Gelato & café · Kiyamachi, the Kakimoto pâtissier’s casual house] The casual sister of Assemblages Kakimoto: a nine-seat counter for small pizzas and the fruit curry that ends the Kakimoto course, and an upstairs room for gelato in unusual pairings — shiso-strawberry, cardamom-chamomile, peach with sherry — under a meringue bear, plus a monthly kakigori in summer. No service charge. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: A chef (food) and a pâtissier (sweets), not named for this shop; sister of Assemblages Kakimoto (kyoto_assemblages_kakimoto)
chef_bio.background: Opened 6 November 2023 (Tabelog). The shop blurb describes a hideaway in a Japanese-style space with the chef’s dishes on the first floor and the pâtissier’s sweets and gelato upstairs. An August 2026 diner calls it the place to eat the full-size version of the mini fruit curry served at the end of the dinner course at the main shop, Assemblages Kakimoto; another says the gelato shows the ingredient pairings Kakimoto is known for. The lunch set ended in June 2026 (June 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 regular: "you can enjoy the full-size version of the mini curry served at the end of the dinner course at the main branch."
A July 2026 diner skipped the August peach kakigori: "the gelato contains sherry, and since I’m not a fan of alcohol…"
September 2026: a triple scoop for ¥972 — "In Tokyo, I think this would cost around JPY 1,200."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: assemblages+、ケーキ・ジェラート・カフェ、中京区木屋町484、丸太町駅から徒歩約7分、月木金土 12:00〜21:00、日 12:00〜18:00、火水休み、ランチとカフェは12:00〜17:00、ディナーは18:00〜21:00でメニューが異なる、1階カウンター9席 (2階のフリースペース約20席)、予約可、禁煙、子供可、アレルギー表示あり、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、サービス料は原文で「無し」、2023年11月6日オープン、1階でシェフの料理、2階でパティシエのスイーツとジェラート。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年10月、英語): アッサンブラージュ カキモトのディナーの締めのミニカレーのフルサイズ版のフルーツカレー (Kameoka・Kumamoto の牛)、季節のピザ1,980円、ビスマルク1,870円、マルゲリータ、ジェラートのダブル864円・トリプル972円・スペシャル1,650円、赤紫蘇と苺、バナナとレモンとココナッツ、カルダモンとカモミール、桃とシェリー、チーズと黒胡椒、Joyo の無花果と白ワインとアニス、メレンゲのクマ、7月はメロン・8月は桃のかき氷、ミニパウンドケーキ800円台、アフォガート、ランチセットは6月で終了。

kyoto_shuto_yanagino.gf_detail: Ask: drinks are mostly wine, cocktails and whisky; the snacks include kara-age and fried oysters (January 2026).
kyoto_shuto_yanagino.vegan_detail: Not vegan: snacks of sashimi, fried oysters and cheese (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shuto_yanagino.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 17:00–24:00; hours may change. 14 seats — 8 at a long single-slab counter and 6 at tables with a garden view, usable as a private room for 8; non-smoking, ashtray in the garden (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, Amex, Diners), no e-money or QR. No drink menu — tell the bartender what you feel like (March 2025); food prices are not listed, and one diner’s bill came out higher than expected (October 2025). Moved from Teramachi to Sanjo-Shinmachi (Tabelog; April 2019 review).
kyoto_shuto_yanagino.notes: [Bar · Sanjo-Shinmachi, antique vessels and a garden room] A softly lit bar on Sanjo, open since 1997 by an owner who trained with an antique dealer: a long one-slab counter, a back room over a small garden, beautiful old glassware and ceramics, cocktails made to your mood and natural-leaning wine, plus proper snacks with Kyoto vegetables. No drink menu and no prices shown, so one diner found the bill higher than expected. Open nightly till midnight.

roles: Owner, not named; trained under an antique dealer (June 2026)
chef_bio.background: A June 2026 diner says the bar has run since 1997 and that the owner, who studied under an antique dealer, brings old vessels and tea-room culture into the space. Tabelog notes it moved from Teramachi-dori (Anekoji-nishi-iru) to its current place; a regular has come since the Teramachi days (April 2019). Reviewers describe a brick-walled entrance, a long wooden counter, a garden at the back, knowledgeable staff, and seasonal events.

anecdotes.text: "There is no drink menu; instead, you can tell the bartender your mood or what you feel like drinking, and they will create something for you." — March 2025.
October 2025: "I was a bit nervous ordering since the prices weren’t listed. In the end, the final bill was higher than I expected."
June 2026: "I felt it might be a type of bar where evaluations vary depending on one’s compatibility with the establishment’s style."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 酒陶 柳野、バー・ワインバー、中京区三条新町西入ル、烏丸三条から西へ徒歩約5分、毎日 17:00〜24:00、14席 (カウンター8、庭が見えるテーブル6)、個室8名、禁煙 (庭に灰皿)、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可、電子マネー・QR不可、寺町通姉小路西入ル南側から移転。口コミ (2019〜2026年、英語): 1997年から営業、骨董商に学んだ店主、古い器と茶室の文化、レンガの入口と一枚板の長いカウンター、奥に庭、ドリンクメニューはなく気分を伝えて作ってもらう、季節の果物のカクテル、タリスカーのハイボール、ワイン (グラスは白赤2種、クリュ・ボージョレ1,800円)、京野菜のつまみ、刺身、銀杏の唐揚げ、牡蠣フライ、鰆のフライと春菊、ロックフォールと蜂蜜、Nishiki の魚屋の魚、値段の表示がなく会計が予想より高かった (2025年10月)、相性で評価が分かれる店という声。

cultural_comfort.note: No drink menu or prices shown; you order by conversation with the bartender.

kyoto_sherry_club_ishibekoji.gf_detail: Ask. Iberico ham, olives, marinated sardines, ajillo with bread, paella and venison; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_sherry_club_ishibekoji.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options; most dishes are ham, seafood or meat (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_sherry_club_ishibekoji.hours_raw: Tue–Fri 15:00–24:00; Sat 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–24:00; Sun 12:00–23:00 (the official site gives Sun 12:00–22:00); closed Monday (Tabelog; official site). Bookings by phone, Tabelog or e-mail. Charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「550円（付出代として）」 — ¥550 as an appetizer charge. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 21 seats per Tabelog — 9 at the counter, 8 at tables; a December 2025 diner counted six counter seats and two tables in a half-basement. Designated smoking area; children welcome (Tabelog). In a converted storehouse on the stone-walled Ishibe-koji lane, a short walk from Yasaka Shrine; 10 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_sherry_club_ishibekoji.notes: [Sherry & Spanish · Ishibe-koji by Yasaka Shrine] A hideaway bar in an old storehouse on the stone-walled lane, where the owner talks you through sherries from bone-dry to sweet — try the three-glass tasting — with jamón, ajillo, sardines and paella. About ¥5,000–10,000. Open from mid-afternoon to midnight; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 7 October 2008 (Tabelog); the Kyoto shop of Sherry Club, whose other bar is in Ginza (official site). Reviewers describe the master guiding first-timers at the counter (2025–26).
chef_bio.philosophy: Sherry for every moment — aperitif, with food, and after (official site).

anecdotes.text: A first-timer in August 2024 was told it was fine to ask anything; by July 2026, on a third yearly visit, nine sherries were tasted while listening to the chef across the counter.
An October 2025 visitor noted a "Silence" sign in the alley and wrote that "you won't find any foreign guests" here; the barman's performances of earlier years seemed to have ended.
When a March 2026 guest mentioned how hard sherry is to find back home, the staff looked up places to recommend.
A July 2026 regular of the Ginza shop heard that the soda in the rebujito differs between the two bars.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: しぇりークラブ、銀座店 (中央区銀座6-3-17) と京都店 (東山区下河原町489-2)、京都店は火〜金 15:00〜24:00、土 12:00〜15:00・17:00〜24:00、日 12:00〜22:00、シェリー酒は辛口から甘口まで食前・食中・食後に。食べログ (店舗会員): しぇりークラブ 京都･石塀小路、スペイン料理・バル・ヨーロッパ料理、祇園四条駅から徒歩10分、月曜休み、付出代550円、21席 (カウンター9・テーブル8)、分煙、カード可、子供可、2008年10月7日オープン、石塀小路の蔵、パエリアとアヒージョ。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年9月、英語): マスターのシェリーの説明、3種の飲み比べ、イベリコ豚の生ハム (アフリカ豚熱で輸入停止)、イワシのマリネ、えびときのこのアヒージョ、Ezo の鹿肉、魚介のパエリア、半地下の空間、外国人客はいないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: The master explains each sherry at the counter.

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the shop and the official site; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_mimaderi.gf_detail: Ask. Skewers with sauce or salt, obanzai in dashi, kara-age, beef cutlet and kitsune udon (2026 reviews).
kyoto_mimaderi.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and there are vegetable skewers and salads, but obanzai use dashi (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_mimaderi.hours_raw: Mon and Sat 17:30–23:00; Tue–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Sunday, and the last day of long holidays (Tabelog). Bookings taken; all-you-can-drink courses; lunch queues form after 11:30 (Tabelog; July 2026 review). Charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「お一人様200円（コースの場合は除きます）」 — ¥200 per person, except with a course. English menu (Tabelog). 44 seats: counter and tables downstairs; tatami, sunken-kotatsu and terrace seats upstairs; parties of up to 30. Designated smoking area. Cards, e-money, PayPay (Tabelog). In a bright machiya with a lantern, two blocks along Anekoji from Karasuma-dori, then left; 3 min from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_mimaderi.notes: [Kushiyaki & obanzai · near Karasuma Oike] A lantern-lit machiya izakaya with about fifty kinds of skewers, Kyoto obanzai and local sake, and tatami rooms upstairs for groups. Lunch sets are cheap and draw queues; dinner about ¥3,000–5,000, plus ¥200 per person. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a machiya izakaya of kushiyaki and obanzai; a September 2026 reviewer returning after more than ten years found the lantern still there.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 lunch guest walked in at 11:30 and left to find a queue outside.
A September 2026 banquet guest praised the kind phone manner; the ¥4,900 course came to ¥4,570 with a coupon.
An October 2026 diner enjoyed the playful dish names and thought the place should promote itself more on Tabelog.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): みまでり、串焼き・居酒屋・日本料理、中京区姉小路間之町木之下町、烏丸御池駅から徒歩3分、月土 17:30〜23:00、火〜金 11:30〜14:00・17:30〜23:00、日曜休み (連休最終日も休み)、お一人様200円 (コースは除く)、44席 (2階に座敷・掘りごたつ・テラス、1階にテーブル・カウンター)、30名まで、分煙、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、英語メニュー、飲み放題、約50種の串焼きとおばんざい、提灯の町家。口コミ (2026年7〜10月、英語): おばんざい3種盛り (いわしの煮付け、ほうれん草の白ごま和え、なすの煮浸し)、鯛のカルパッチョ、10種の野菜サラダ、鶏むねの梅しそ、生ハム巻きモッツァレラ、焼き鳥5種盛り、串付ききつねうどん、安いランチ (牛カツ、唐揚げ、鯖の味噌煮と小さなカレー)、4,900円のコースと牛しぐれご飯。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog).

kyoto_tokumaru.gf_detail: Ask. Dashi and soy-based kappo dishes, tempura and a menchi katsu; no gluten information (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_tokumaru.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish and meat kappo cooking in dashi (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_tokumaru.hours_raw: 17:30–23:00 (last food order 22:00); closed Wednesday, over the New Year and on occasional other days (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Three omakase courses or à la carte from a long daily menu — a few dishes come first, then you order freely; a February 2024 diner found no prices on the menu (Tabelog; 2024–25 reviews). Cards (Tabelog). 9 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). On a back street behind Kyoto City Hall; 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; April 2025 review).
kyoto_tokumaru.notes: [Kappo counter · behind Kyoto City Hall] A white nine-seat counter where the chef cooks the season to order — omakase (about ¥14,000) or à la carte from a long list: nodoguro with eggplant, hamo, black-maitake tempura, an eel-tempura rice ball. About ¥10,000–20,000. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 19 November 2022 (Tabelog). A July 2025 reviewer says it was started by the head chef of "Oshikouji Yuuki", which served Kyoto cuisine à la carte; an August 2026 diner notes it runs mainly with a single chef.

anecdotes.text: In April 2024 the first dish a regular ordered turned out to be one the "playful" chef had forgotten to source.
A November 2025 diner wanted to take the eel-tempura rice ball home, but there were no containers — and asked the shop to consider takeout.
A diner of six visits came back at the end of summer 2026 for whelk, surf clam and grouper.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 徳まる、日本料理、中京区亀屋町406、京都市役所前駅から徒歩5分、17:30〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、水曜休み (年末年始ほか不定休)、カウンター9席、禁煙、カード可、2022年11月19日オープン、旬の食材のおまかせコース3種と一品料理、鹿児島の焼酎と日本酒10種。口コミ (2024年1月〜2026年8月、英語): 市役所裏の路地、白木のカウンター、おまかせ14,000円、肉じゃがサラダ、のどぐろと焼きなす、鱧の梅肉、いちじくの酒煮、黒舞茸の天ぷら、白子焼き、鰻天むす、grouper、ビワマス、アブラボウズ、Tsuki no Wa Kuma のメンチカツ、品書きに値段がないという声、Oshikouji Yuuki の料理長が始めた店、ほぼ一人の料理人。

cultural_comfort.note: Japanese-only à la carte counter; the menu may not show prices.

kyoto_erutan_good_nature.gf_detail: Ask. Wood-fired pizza and pasta are wheat; salads, fish and roast pork also served; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_erutan_good_nature.vegan_detail: Ask. A salad bar with many vegetables and dressings at lunch, but most dishes have cheese, ham, fish or meat (2026 reviews).
kyoto_erutan_good_nature.hours_raw: Breakfast 7:00–10:00 (last order 9:30); lunch 11:30–14:00; café 14:00–17:00 (last order 16:30); dinner 17:30–22:00 (last orders food 21:00, drinks 21:30); bar 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); irregular closures with the facility; closed 31 December–2 January (Tabelog). Bookings taken; same-day cancellations and no-shows are charged 100% (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay. 95 seats with a counter and sofas, two private rooms for 6–12; wheelchair accessible; children welcome with high chairs; non-smoking; parking in the building (Tabelog). Lunch buffet runs 90 minutes and is often full on weekdays — book (2026 reviews). 1F of GOOD NATURE STATION, just before Takashimaya on Kawaramachi; 2 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn exit 4 (Tabelog).
kyoto_erutan_good_nature.notes: [Italian, pizza & bar · Kawaramachi-Shijo] The big, stylish ground-floor dining room of GOOD NATURE STATION, open from breakfast to the late bar: a lunch buffet of salad bar and wood-fired pizza, seasonal afternoon tea, and a ¥5,000 sharing course at night. Lunch ¥2,000–3,000; dinner ¥5,000–8,000. Wheelchair accessible.

roles: Restaurant of GOOD NATURE STATION (no person named)
chef_bio.background: Opened 9 December 2019; renewed on 15 April (Tabelog). The ground-floor restaurant and bar of GOOD NATURE STATION, whose building also houses Hyssop, RAU, TAKAYAMA and VELROSIER.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal ingredients and authentic technique, with oven-baked pizza, in a casual setting (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 buffet guest liked the Miyama-milk cheese with honey but felt hurried by the next person in the salad line.
Turned away by long queues elsewhere near Kawaramachi in October 2026, a visitor found a seat at once in the spacious café at the back.
A Friday-night diner in October 2026 found it full by 19:00 and paid just over ¥8,000 each with two glasses of wine.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): ERUTAN RESTAURANT BAR、イタリアン・ダイニングバー・パスタ、下京区河原町通四条下ル2丁目稲荷町318-6 GOOD NATURE STATION 1F、京都河原町駅4番出口から徒歩2分、朝食 7:00〜10:00、ランチ 11:30〜14:00、カフェ 14:00〜17:00、ディナー 17:30〜22:00、バー 18:00〜23:00、不定休 (施設に準ずる)、12月31日〜1月2日休み、当日キャンセルは100%、95席、個室2室、車椅子可、子供可 (キッズチェア)、禁煙、施設の駐車場、2019年12月9日オープン、4月15日リニューアル、薪窯のピッツァと地元の食材。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年11月、英語): ランチビュッフェ (サラダバー、ピッツァ3種、生ハム、美山の牛乳のチーズ、パスタ)、ぶどうのアフタヌーンティー、ERUTAN SPECIARE シェアコース5,000円、鰆、ジェノベーゼ、奥のカフェ。

cultural_comfort.note: Large hotel-complex restaurant; wheelchair accessible.

kyoto_yoshoku_wine_ao.gf_detail: Ask. Yoshoku with breaded croquettes and cutlets, fried shrimp, sauces and baguette; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_yoshoku_wine_ao.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu-hamburg and seafood yoshoku menu (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_yoshoku_wine_ao.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00, last entry 20:30); Saturday 16:00–22:00; closed Sunday (open when Monday is a holiday) and two other days a month (Tabelog). Earlier reviews mention a lunch course (October–November 2025); Tabelog now lists dinner only. À la carte carries a ¥300 seat charge per person (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「アラカルトは席料としてお一人様300円(税込)」). 15 seats: a 9-seat wooden counter and 6 at tables; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay (Tabelog). An easy-to-miss street-level entrance on Sanjo-dori west of Karasuma, past NHK, 261 m from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog; January 2026).
kyoto_yoshoku_wine_ao.notes: [Yoshoku · Sanjo-Karasuma, wagyu hamburg and wine at the counter] A calm, grown-up yoshoku room behind an easy-to-miss door on Sanjo-dori, with a long wooden counter. The draw is a 100% Kuroge wagyu hamburg in several sauces — or with foie gras — plus uni cream croquettes and a rare-fried wagyu cutlet, matched with wine. Order à la carte (¥300 seat charge) or the ¥10,800 course. Dinner only; closed Sunday.

roles: Chef not named; operator 株式会社LINO DREAM WORKS (invoice holder), which also runs Lino
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: a cosy 15-seat restaurant at Karasuma-Oike serving Western dishes centred on 100% Kuroge wagyu hamburg and seasonal ingredients, as courses or à la carte, with wines to match. The invoice number belongs to 株式会社LINO DREAM WORKS, a Kyoto Italian-restaurant company that also operates Lino (a separate record).

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 dinner guest was met outside by staff confirming the booking and shown in.
An October 2026 pair booked the ¥10,800 course for the uni cream croquette and foie-gras hamburg and were given a table for four.
A January 2026 diner tried the hamburg in several sauces and liked the salt version best.

cultural_comfort.note: Counter seating; staff explain each dish.

kyoto_mikazuki_hyoka_ten.gf_detail: Ask. Shaved ice with fruit syrups, mascarpone or cheese, ice cream and red-bean paste; some bowls add peanuts or mousse; no gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_mikazuki_hyoka_ten.vegan_detail: Ask. Fruit syrups over ice, but most bowls include ice cream, cheese, mascarpone or condensed milk (2026 reviews).
kyoto_mikazuki_hyoka_ten.hours_raw: 11:00–18:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Queues can form before opening in summer (August 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 14 seats: 4 at a counter with a garden view and 10 at tables; non-smoking; VISA and QR (Tabelog; September 2026). Tea or cold water and a small snack are served with the ice (August 2026). In a renovated townhouse in a quiet lane near Kiyomizu-Gojo, 381 m from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened here 27 April 2024; reviewers say it moved from Kashiwa, Chiba (Tabelog; August–September 2026).
kyoto_mikazuki_hyoka_ten.notes: [Sweets · Kiyomizu-Gojo, year-round kakigori in a townhouse] A kakigori specialist that moved from Kashiwa, Chiba, to a quiet Kyoto townhouse near Kiyomizu-Gojo, with a counter looking onto a little garden. The ice is shaved into fine, wide ribbons that melt at once, under house syrups of the season's fruit — fig with cheese and peanuts, peach, Kyoho grape — with ice cream hidden inside. About ¥1,500 a bowl; a favourite of penguin fans. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: a well-known kakigori shop from Kashiwa, Chiba, that relocated to Kyoto; Tabelog gives the Kyoto opening as 27 April 2024. Reviewers note large ice-shaving machines, seasonal limited bowls and attentive staff who pour warm tea.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor who had queued for it years ago in the Tokyo area was surprised to find the shop had moved to Kyoto.
An August 2026 guest was offered a choice of warm tea or cold water with the ice.
A July 2026 regular on a second visit switched from mango to melon, with extra melon juice and mascarpone inside.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 三日月氷菓店、かき氷、東山区下新シ町329、清水五条駅から381m、11:00〜18:00、水曜定休、14席 (カウンター4、テーブル10)、禁煙、VISA・QR 可、2024年4月27日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 千葉・柏から京都へ移転、町家を改装、庭の見えるカウンター、薄く幅広に削る氷、通年のかき氷、季節限定 (城陽のいちじくとチーズとピーナッツ1,500円、桃、杏、メロンとマスカルポーネ、マンゴー、巨峰)、抹茶アイス入りのミルク金時、練乳はかけ放題、温かいお茶、ペンギン。

cultural_comfort.note: Point at the seasonal board; expect a queue in summer.
